name: orbital-std
description: The 'standard orbital' pipeline kit: the orbital_std/regolith_std cultures, the courier ship, the trade_ring station, the regolith_moon, and the small settlement building set (market_hall, housing_block, admin_office, planter, lamp_post, crates, plus the pipeline bench/column) - now with their per-name graphics files (buildings, collision, decorations, interiors, ships, stations), absorbed from figures-human in 2.0.0 since none of it is a human figure or wardrobe piece. Extracted so any story can reuse the same look with zero new assets.
